name: Maxis Berhad
overview: 2026年，Maxis 通过其全资子公司 Maxis Broadband 拟以最高 8300 万令吉收购 MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems 的宽带业务资产，以扩展宽带业务；其他公告主要为股息、股东大会及关联交易常规事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Maxis, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Maxis Broadband, proposed to acquire the broadband business assets of MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems for up to RM83 million to expand its broadband business; other announcements were mainly routine matters on dividends, general meetings and related party transactions.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 集团层面推进宽带业务资产收购，以扩展宽带业务。
segments.note_en: At group level, the company is pursuing the acquisition of broadband business assets to expand its broadband business.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Maxis Broadband 拟以最高 8300 万令吉现金收购 MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems 的宽带业务资产。
actions.text_en: Maxis Broadband proposed to acquire the broadband business assets of MEASAT Broadcast Network Systems for a cash consideration of up to RM83 million.
